items.example: Travelling by train is more relaxing than driving.

note.en: Use '-er than' with short adjectives: cheaper than, not 'more cheap than'.
note.es: Con adjetivos cortos usa «-er than»: «cheaper than», no «more cheap than».

items.example: The new office is not as bright as the old one.
My brother's job is similar to mine, but he works shorter hours.
Life in the city is very different from life in the country.

note.en: 'Different from' is the safest choice in British English.
note.es: «Different from» es lo más seguro en inglés británico.

items.example: Compared with last year, the number of visitors has doubled.
Working here is much the same as working in my last company.
The more you practise listening, the easier it becomes.

note.en: Keep both parts parallel and do not add 'then'.
note.es: Mantén las dos partes paralelas y no añadas «then».

items.example: There's no comparison between a paper map and a good phone app.
The cost of the course pales in comparison with the benefits it brings.
The modern high street bears little resemblance to the one my parents knew.
The standard of the local clinic is on a par with that of the city hospital.

note.en: Means of equal quality or level.

items.example: The second proposal is far superior to the first in terms of cost.
